title: A neural network forward pass
description: Watch a signal pass through a small neural network.
alt: A two-input, three-hidden-node, one-output-node network with left-to-right activation.

requirements.description: Render a schematic feed-forward neural network with 2 input nodes, 3 hidden nodes, and 1 output node. Show activation flowing from left to right, followed by a short hold. Use a white background and a readable Arial-family title. Deliver 1080p H.264 video at 30 fps. This is an architecture demonstration; do not imply numerical weights or predictions.
Produce a valid MP4 file and PNG thumbnail.
Use LaTeX for all math and Arial-family prose.
